unknown_rule: UNKNOWN never inherits HUMAN_ONLY or independently-reviewed guarantees.
constitutional_admission: Constitutional changes require an applicable trusted human approval from the protected base or sufficiently independent exact review as allowed by the protected base policy; request-supplied booleans never satisfy this requirement.
ordinary_ai_assisted_admission: AI-assisted material changes require at least one ExactReviewBinding plus executable tests/evidence; HIGH/CRITICAL or semantic changes require additional independence unless trusted human approval explicitly covers the change.
